full_prompt_en: A vertically framed city painting within a narrow white margin shows an elevated view down a broad riverside boulevard after rain. The pale green river fills the left side and narrows toward a low bridge in the middle distance. Several small dark boats rest on the water, their simple shapes becoming smaller as they approach the bridge. At the far left, a line of trees and low buildings follows the opposite bank beneath a wide gray-blue sky. On the near bank, two parallel roadways curve toward the distance, divided by a planted strip of leafy green trees. A cream-and-yellow streetcar travels along the outer road beside the water near the lower left. Tiny pedestrians and indistinct vehicles appear farther up the wet avenue, but none dominates the scene. The right side is anchored by a large pale stone building with many windows, a high dark blue roof, and a narrow spire reaching into the sky. Its wall catches slightly warmer light than the road or river. Beyond it, another domed roof rises over the tree canopy. The pavement is a long field of silver, ochre, and muted lavender strokes, reflecting the overcast light and pulling the eye toward the bridge. Brushwork is loose enough that distant people and boats become colored marks, while the major architectural lines remain readable. The viewpoint gives a broad sweep of urban space, with the near roadway starting at the lower edge and the river leading steadily into a hazy horizon. Cool sky and water tones are balanced by the streetcar and pale golden building, making the rainy scene airy and quietly active rather than gloomy.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅带窄白边的纵向城市绘画，从高处俯看雨后的宽阔河滨大道。淡绿色河水占据左侧，向中远处一座低桥收窄。几艘深色小船停在水上，越接近桥，形状越小。最左边，树列与低矮建筑沿对岸延伸，头顶是一大片灰蓝天空。近岸两条平行道路向远方弯去，中间由种满绿叶树的隔离带分开。一辆奶油黄的有轨电车沿临水外侧道路行进，位置在左下附近。更远的湿路面上有细小行人和难辨车辆，但没有谁占据主体。右侧由一栋大型浅色石建筑压住，建筑有许多窗户、深蓝色高屋顶，以及伸入天空的狭细尖顶。墙面比道路和河面承受稍暖的光。它后方另一处圆顶越过树冠升起。路面由银色、赭色和低调淡紫色笔触铺成，映着阴天的光，也把目光引向桥梁。笔触足够松散，远处人影和船只化为色点，主要建筑线条却仍可辨。这个视点展开宽阔城市空间，近处道路从下缘起步，河流则稳定导向朦胧地平线。冷色天空和水面由电车与淡金建筑平衡，使雨景显得透气、安静而有活动，而非阴郁。
style_prompt_en: Observational urban painting with an elevated viewpoint, broad receding routes, and soft atmospheric perspective. Use loose, visible brushstrokes to describe wet surfaces, foliage, and distant traffic, while keeping a few strong architectural outlines legible. A cool gray-blue sky and pale green water can occupy large calm areas; muted ochre, cream, and lavender marks bring warmth into the built forms and reflected pavement. Wet ground should shimmer through broken light strokes rather than mirror-sharp reflections. Small figures and vehicles are economical dabs that support scale and lived activity. Organize the view with converging roads, railings, riverbanks, or other long lines leading toward a hazy middle distance. Keep the treatment airy despite dense urban subject matter, allowing sky and water to provide visual rest. The mood is matter-of-fact, luminous, and gently animated by ordinary movement.
style_prompt_zh: 观察性的城市绘画采用高视点、宽阔后退的通道和柔和空气透视。以松散可见的笔触描绘湿表面、树叶与远处交通，同时让几条主要建筑轮廓保持可辨。冷灰蓝天空与淡绿水面可以占据大片宁静区域，低调赭色、奶油色和淡紫色笔痕为建筑与反光路面带来暖意。湿地面通过断续亮笔触闪动，而非镜面般锐利的倒影。小人物和车辆是节省的色点，用来支持尺度与生活活动。用收敛的道路、栏杆、河岸或其他长线把目光引向朦胧中景。即使城市内容密集，处理仍需透气，让天空与水提供视觉停歇。气质平实、明亮，被日常移动轻轻激活。
theme_en: An elevated painted view of a rainy riverside boulevard, streetcar, bridge, and grand stone building
theme_zh: 一幅从高处俯看的雨后河滨大道绘画，画中有有轨电车、桥梁与宏伟石建筑
name: Gustave Caillebotte
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
